- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org.
- Optimize Classroom Assignment = ON for Riso.
- Location = Riso Shinjuku; lesson_date = 2026-07-23.

steps_data:

title: [Riso] Classroom Adjustment – Completion summary – One reassignment – Required message and counters appear
description: AC-04 — Component — A completed adjustment presents the specified feedback.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org.
- Optimize Classroom Assignment = ON; Location = Riso Shinjuku; lesson_date = 2026-07-23.
- Student A has Individual lessons at 09:00 and 11:00; Room A is available for both lessons.
steps_actions:
1. Open Daily View and run Classroom Adjustment.
2. Read the completion feedback.
steps_result:
1. The adjustment completes for the selected scope.
2. The message is `Classroom adjustment completed`; Previous room applied, Sequence assigned, Skipped, Clash resolved, and Clash unresolved (kept as-is) are all displayed.
steps_data:
1. lesson_date = 2026-07-23; Student A: 09:00 Room A, 11:00 unassigned candidate
2. expected text = Classroom adjustment completed

title: [Riso] Classroom Adjustment – Completion summary – No eligible lessons – Zero-update result appears
description: AC-04 — Negative — A valid empty scope still returns readable completion feedback.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org.
- Optimize Classroom Assignment = ON; Location = Riso Shinjuku; lesson_date = 2026-07-24.
- The selected scope has no Individual lessons.
steps_actions:
1. Run Classroom Adjustment from Daily View.
2. Read the completion feedback.
steps_result:
1. The run completes without changing any lesson.
2. `Classroom adjustment completed` is displayed with all required counter labels and zero updates.
steps_data:
1. location = Riso Shinjuku; lesson_date = 2026-07-24; Individual lessons = 0
2. expected updated lessons = 0

title: [Riso] Classroom Adjustment – Print flow – Completed reassignment – Print Out remains available
description: AC-05 — Regression — Adjustment does not block the existing Daily PDF flow.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org.
- Optimize Classroom Assignment = ON; Location = Riso Shinjuku; lesson_date = 2026-07-23.
- Student A has a confirmed reassignment from Room B to Room A after adjustment.
steps_actions:
1. Run Classroom Adjustment and dismiss the completion feedback.
2. Select Print Out.
steps_result:
1. Daily View remains available after the run.
2. The existing Print Out flow opens and includes Student A with Room A.
steps_data:
1. Student A = Room B to Room A
2. expected classroom in print flow = Room A

title: [Riso] Classroom Adjustment – Completion summary – Pre-existing clash resolved – Clash result is surfaced
description: AC-04, AC-17 — Decision Table — A corrected duplicate is represented in the summary.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org.
- Optimize Classroom Assignment = ON; Location = Riso Shinjuku; lesson_date = 2026-07-23.
- Two Individual lessons at 10:00 are assigned to Room A; Room B is an available Private classroom with Sequence 2.
steps_actions:
1. Run Classroom Adjustment.
2. Read the completion feedback.
steps_result:
1. One duplicated lesson is reassigned to Room B and the other remains in Room A.
2. Clash resolved shows `1` for the resolved duplicate.
steps_data:
1. 10:00 duplicate = Lesson 100 in Room A, Lesson 101 in Room A; Room B sequence = 2
2. expected Clash resolved = 1

title: [Riso] Classroom Adjustment – Invalid trigger payload – Missing location or lesson date – Apex is not called
description: AC-03, AC-04 — Negative — The Calendar LWC guard must not run classroom adjustment without required Daily View context.
preconditions:
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Riso Salesforce org.
- Optimize Classroom Assignment = ON.
- Test harness can observe the `ClassroomReassignmentController.reassign` Apex call or network request.
steps_actions:
1. Trigger `optimizeClassroomAssignment` with `teachingMethod = Individual` and blank `locationId`.
2. Trigger `optimizeClassroomAssignment` with `teachingMethod = Individual` and blank `lessonDate`.
3. Trigger `optimizeClassroomAssignment` with `teachingMethod = Group`.
steps_result:
1. The action returns without calling Apex and no success summary is shown.
2. The action returns without calling Apex and no classroom records are changed.
3. The action returns without calling Apex.
steps_data:
1. locationId = blank; lessonDate = 2026-07-23
2. locationId = Riso Shinjuku SF Id; lessonDate = blank
3. teachingMethod = Group
